one_trial_files.integrity: Record SHA-256 of both files in the eventual dataset manifest. Never overwrite a completed run.

csv.sampling: One row per received feedback record, in receive order; do not interpolate or silently drop duplicates.

required_columns.t_receive_s: receive timestamp on the same monotonic host clock
required_columns.release_event: 0 before the declared release boundary, 1 on its first sample, otherwise 0
required_columns.motor_enabled: 0|1; describe the exact meaning in metadata
required_columns.position_cmd_rad: requested command when a command is still transmitted; empty only when genuinely unavailable
required_columns.torque_feedback_Nm: decoded firmware/controller estimate; not an independent output-torque measurement
required_columns.feedback_gap_s: time since the previous accepted feedback record
required_columns.exclusion_code: empty for accepted samples; otherwise stable documented reason

minimum_design_guidance.start_conditions: Use multiple safely separated start angles and both directions where mechanically possible; freeze them before final collection.
minimum_design_guidance.failed_trials: Retain aborted or rejected trials with reason codes; they do not count toward accepted repeats.

hard_prohibitions: Do not label torque_feedback_Nm as measured joint torque.
Do not mix drive-enabled zero-gain and torque-disabled trials under one condition ID.
Do not synthesize unavailable timestamps, command acknowledgements, current, voltage, temperature, or fault fields.
Do not use free-fall trials as calibration rows in the closed-loop passive-joint fit without a separate declared model and contract.
